title: erophila verna var. krockeri
intro: Erophila verna var. krockeri, commonly known as Rockcress, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which may include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockcress may include reducing oxidative stress, modulating immune responses, and exhibiting cytotoxic activity against certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Rockcress include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential medicinal properties.
